name: The headdress of a Chinese woman
summary: The head and shoulders of the young woman (probably a boatwoman) are seen from behind; she wears earrings, and her hair is looped and pinned behind.  See also E.2125-1921, and compare John Thomson's photographs of 'Boat Women of Canton' taken in 1869-70.
